title: 第126章 终于喝上一口水
slug: 我一值夜班全院主任都睡不着
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

林野刚写完最后一格，手还没从纸边挪开，急诊入口又有人喊道。

“城南夜市摊主夫妻到了！”

赵护士原本已经拧开保温杯，听见这句，杯盖又扣了回去。

“得，这口水先记账。”

两辆平车一前一后推进来。

郭姐躺在前面那张，口唇发灰，眼睛红得厉害，人还清醒，一看见护士就想撑着胳膊起来。

“医生，我真不知道那不是盐。我就拌了几盆菜，我老公呢？他刚才在车上一直吐，人都快叫不清了。”

赵护士伸手把她按回去，动作不重，话却一点没软。

“你先躺好。你老公在后面，马上推进来。你别一激动再吐出来。”

郭姐的眼泪一下掉下来。

“他要是出了事，我这辈子都过不去。”

后面那张平车上，郭姐丈夫被推了进来。

男人三十多岁，工作围裙还没来得及解，胸前沾着红油和雨水混出来的暗印。他人没昏过去，可眼神发木，别人喊他名字，他要慢半拍才转一下头。

随车急救员把转运单递给孙志强。

“男，三十八岁。吃过凉拌牛肉，途中吐了两次。上车时口唇发紫，吸氧后颜色没怎么回来。一路说胸口堵，刚才问他家里电话，答了两遍都不一样。”

孙志强接过单子，第一反应是看红区。

正式床位已经占满。

蓝色工装那边刚接上监护，东苑女孩还在儿童监护位，刚才嘴硬的中年男人也没下监护。

赵护士扫了一圈，已经开始叫人挪平车。

“先靠观察位，氧气和导联接上。”

林野看着郭姐丈夫。

男人又干呕了一下，身体往一侧偏，护送护士赶紧把弯盘递过去。吐出来的不多，只有一点混着红油味的水，呛得他咳了好几声。

咳完之后，他没有马上抬头。

嘴唇那层灰紫色，反而更明显。

林野视野角落里，淡蓝色字迹亮了一下。

【急诊预警系统】

【疑似病名：亚硝酸盐中毒，急性高铁血红蛋白血症。】

【异常点：反复呕吐、反应变慢，吸氧后口唇仍发灰。】

【重点风险：气道风险上升。】

林野只扫了一眼，视线又落回郭姐丈夫身上。

男人还在咳，头始终没完全抬起来。

他心里骂了一句，抬头看向孙志强，声音比刚才急了一点。

“孙老师，这个不能先放观察位。”

孙志强转过脸。

林野指了指平车旁的弯盘，又看向郭姐丈夫还没完全抬起来的头。

“孙老师，他不能离红区太远。路上吐两回，刚才一咳头都抬不起来，吸着氧嘴唇颜色也没变化。吸引放床边，二线得先过来看看气道。”

马昊下意识看了一眼红区。

“可那边已经满了。”

“满了也不能让他躺远了。”林野没看马昊，语速很快，“真吐起来，旁边没人盯着，呛进去更麻烦。”

孙志强只迟了两秒。

他低头看了眼转运单，又看了一眼郭姐丈夫的脸色。

“赵护士，别放观察位。平车靠红区监护旁，吸引备好。二线先看这个。”

赵护士已经把吸引管从治疗车边上抽出来。

“听见了。小郑，推这边来，头偏一点。马昊，腕带别写错。”

马昊赶紧应声。

“知道，郭姐丈夫。”

郭姐听见“红区”两个字，挣扎着想扭头看。

“他是不是很重？医生，他是不是比我严重？”

赵护士把她这边的氧气面罩扣好。

“你也别逞能。你俩现在谁都不轻。你能说话，就先把话留着，等会儿问你从哪儿拿的料、拌了几盆、谁吃过，你再慢慢说。”

郭姐闭了一下眼，眼泪从眼角往下滑。

“我真不是故意的。”

林野站在两张平车中间，笔尖在纸上停了停。

红区那边孩子的监护声还在响，东苑女孩的母亲隔着半道帘子还在小声问医生。

孙志强看了他一眼。

“林野，别站着。到院时间先补上。男的那几条也写上，吐、反应慢、吸氧后变化不明显。病名先别急着写上去，让二线和结果说话。”

“明白。”

林野拿起笔，刚写了两行，急诊二线医生已经从蓝色工装那边走过来。

他先看郭姐丈夫，又扫了一眼弯盘。

“吐过？”

林野把刚才急救员的话报给他。

“路上两次，到门口又干呕，咳了几声。回答慢，刚才问电话也答错。口唇灰紫，吸氧后变化不明显。”

二线医生没有多问，直接对护士说：“吸引放他手边，先别让他平躺。血气带共氧，电解质、乳酸一起送。”

他看了眼郭姐丈夫发灰的嘴唇，又补了一句。

“蚕豆病、过敏史能问就问，问不清先找电话。亚甲蓝让药房备着，等结果和上级医嘱。”

郭姐丈夫听见“家属电话”，眼皮动了一下。

“别给我妈打。”

声音很低，混在氧气声里差点听不清。

马昊贴腕带的手顿了一下。

第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

Lin Ye had just finished writing the last box, and before he could move his hand from the edge of the paper, someone shouted again at the emergency entrance.

"The Chengnan night market stall owner and his wife are here!"

Nurse Zhao had already unscrewed the thermos cup, but when she heard this, she put the lid back on.

"Okay, let's keep this water in account first."

Two flat cars pushed in one after the other.

Sister Guo was lying in the front, her lips were gray and her eyes were very red. She was still awake. When she saw the nurse, she wanted to stand up with her arms.

"Doctor, I really don't know that it's not salt. I just mixed a few pots of vegetables. Where is my husband? He just kept vomiting in the car and could hardly scream."

Nurse Zhao stretched out her hand to push her back. The movement was not heavy, but the words were not soft at all.

"Lie down first. Your husband is behind, push it in immediately. Don't vomit it out when you get excited."

Sister Guo's tears suddenly fell.

"If something happens to him, I won't be able to live with it for the rest of my life."

On the flat car at the back, Sister Guo's husband was pushed in.

The man was in his thirties and had not yet taken off his work apron. His chest was stained with dark marks mixed with red oil and rain.He didn't faint, but his eyes were dull. When someone called his name, he had to slow down for a moment before turning his head.

The on-board first responder handed the transfer order to Sun Zhiqiang.

"Male, thirty-eight years old. He ate beef salad and vomited twice on the way. His lips were purple when he got in the car, and the color did not come back after inhaling oxygen. He complained of chest congestion all the way. I just asked for his home phone number and the answer was different twice."

When Sun Zhiqiang took over the order, his first reaction was to look at the red zone.

The official beds are already occupied.

The person in the blue overalls had just taken over the supervision. The Dongyuan girl was still in the child supervision position, and the middle-aged man who had just spoken harshly did not take supervision either.

Nurse Zhao scanned around and started asking people to move the cart.

"First rely on the observation position, connect the oxygen and leads."

Lin Ye looked at Sister Guo's husband.

The man retched again and leaned to one side. The escorting nurse quickly handed over the bent plate.Not much was spit out, just a little water mixed with the smell of red oil, which made him cough several times.

After coughing, he didn't look up immediately.

The gray-purple layer on the lips is more obvious.

In the corner of Lin Ye's field of vision, light blue writing lit up.

【Emergency warning system】

[Suspected disease names: nitrite poisoning, acute methemoglobinemia.】

[Abnormal points: repeated vomiting, slow reaction, lips still gray after inhaling oxygen.】

[Key risks: Increased airway risks.】

Lin Ye only glanced at it, and then his eyes fell back on Sister Guo's husband.

The man was still coughing and never fully raised his head.

He cursed in his mind and looked up at Sun Zhiqiang, his voice a little more urgent than before.

"Teacher Sun, you can't put this in the observation position first."

Sun Zhiqiang turned his face.

Lin Ye pointed to the curved plate next to the flat car, and then looked at Sister Guo's husband who had not yet completely raised his head.

"Teacher Sun, he can't be too far away from the red zone. He vomited twice on the way, and he couldn't lift his head when he coughed just now. The color of his lips didn't change even when he was breathing oxygen. Put the suction tube next to the bed, and the second line must come over first to check the airway."

Ma Hao subconsciously glanced at the red zone.

"But it's full over there."

"We can't let him lie far away when it's full." Lin Ye didn't look at Ma Hao and spoke very quickly, "If you really vomit, there's no one around to watch. It would be even more troublesome to choke."

Sun Zhiqiang was only two seconds late.

He lowered his head and glanced at the transfer order, and then at Sister Guo's husband's face.

"Nurse Zhao, don't put the observation position. The flat car is next to the red zone surveillance, and the suction is ready. The second line will look at this first."

Nurse Zhao has already pulled out the suction tube from the side of the treatment cart.

"I heard it. Xiao Zheng, push this way and tilt your head a little. Ma Hao, don't write it wrong on the wristband."

Ma Hao quickly responded.

"I know, Sister Guo's husband."

Sister Guo heard the word "red zone" and struggled to turn her head to look.

"Is he very serious? Doctor, is he more serious than me?"

Nurse Zhao fastened the oxygen mask on her side.

"Don't try too hard. Neither of you are young now. If you can speak, just keep your words for now. When I ask you later where you got the ingredients, how many pots you mixed, and who ate it, you can talk more slowly."

Sister Guo closed her eyes for a moment, tears falling from the corners of her eyes.

"I really didn't mean it."

Lin Ye stood between the two flat cars, his pen tip resting on the paper.

The sound of monitoring the children in the red zone was still ringing, and the mother of the girl from Dongyuan was still asking the doctor in a low voice through half the curtain.

Sun Zhiqiang glanced at him.

"Lin Ye, don't stand there. Make up the time you arrived at the hospital first. Also write down the men's items, including vomiting, slow reaction, and no obvious changes after oxygen inhalation. Don't rush to write down the name of the disease, let the second line speak with the results."

"Understood."

Lin Ye picked up the pen and had just written two lines when the second-line emergency doctor had already walked over from the blue overalls.

He looked at Sister Guo's husband first, and then glanced at the bent disk.

"Ever vomited?"

Lin Ye reported to him what the first responder had just said.

"Two times on the way, I retched and coughed a few times when I got to the door. I was slow to answer, and I also answered wrongly when I asked about the phone number just now. My lips were gray and purple, and the change was not obvious after inhaling oxygen."

The second-line doctor didn't ask any questions and said directly to the nurse: "Put the suction at his hand, but don't let him lie down yet. The blood gas will be co-oxygenated, and the electrolytes and lactic acid will be sent together."

He glanced at Sister Guo's husband's gray lips and added.

"Ask if you can about the history of favismosis and allergies. If you can't ask, call us first. Let the pharmacy prepare the methylene blue and wait for the results and the superior doctor's advice."

Sister Guo's husband heard the "family call" and his eyelids moved.

"Don't call my mother."

The voice was so low that it was almost inaudible mixed with the sound of oxygen.

Ma Hao's hand on the wristband paused.
